Summary insights:
- Total ARR in this snapshot: $6,317,500 (sum of listed accounts) — high concentration in 3 accounts >$1M.
- Immediate attention (probability <= 40 or risk flags present): Atlas Logistics (22%, low adoption), Centric Telecom (19%, competitor RFP), Orchard Finance (35%, competitive RFP + legal).
- Quick wins (probability >= 80): Horizon EDU (90%), Mosaic Interiors (88%), Beacon Labs (82%).
- Legal/Procurement blockers: 4 accounts flagged with active legal review or procurement_on_hold (Nimbus Retail, Orchard Finance, Centric Telecom, Pioneer Biotech).
- Expansion candidates: Pioneer Biotech, Orchard Finance, Verdant Energy — high ARR + expansion_opportunity flagged.
Action items (owner — due):
- Asha: Reach out to Centric Telecom exec (CRO) with counteroffer and case studies — due 2026-12-12.
- Michael: Push legal follow-up with Nimbus + procurement to clear PO — due 2026-12-10.
- Liam: Set up executive sponsor escalation for Orchard Finance; include Solutions Eng — due 2026-12-08.
- Janelle: Prepare Horizon EDU auto-renew confirmation email and finalize billing contact — due 2026-12-11.
Notes for QBR deck (short):
- Slide: Top 3 renewal risks (Centric, Atlas, Orchard) — include current ARR impact and mitigation plan.
- Slide: Quick wins to celebrate (Horizon EDU, Mosaic Interiors) — include usage delta and NPS snippet.
- Slide: Expansion opportunities — propose 3 pilot offers (Verdant Energy usage pilot; Pioneer phased ML roadmap; Beacon Labs multi-year discount).
Unresolved questions / assumptions:
- Procurement timelines are estimates from account contacts; confirm with procurement teams for Centric and Atlas.
- Pipeline probability is blended CS judgement + historical conversion; recommend A/B refresh before QBR if any material changes.
- Playbook refs are internal short links — update with finalized docs when ready.
